title: Solar Installer Customer Handoffs: Align HubSpot Opportunities With Acumatica Project Accounts
summary: Connect solar sales opportunities to approved Acumatica project customers without losing site, payer or scope identity.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Solar installation companies should align HubSpot opportunities with approved Acumatica customers and projects through stable external references. Keep the sales relationship, property or site, legal customer and project distinct. HubSpot can supply approved commercial context and receive project status, while finance and project administration own customer setup and project accounting. Validate the Acumatica entities and operations actually exposed in your environment before enabling automatic project or financial changes.


Explore the complete[solar installation and o&m services integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/solar-installation-service) for the systems and processes around this guide.
